open_window_rebuilds.reason: opening a 400-item thread rebuilds the window for mounting, navigation, each arriving page, composer sizing and the landing; measured 7 to 9

open_section_refreshes.reason: section refreshes are cheaper than window rebuilds, so moving opening work into them stays within budget; measured 0

open_retained_kib.reason: launching into a 400-item thread retains about 6.9 MiB of heap (Editor plus the in-process Forge); the rest is headroom for allocator and font differences between machines

idle_window_rebuilds.reason: a settled thread with no input and no new items must not rebuild or refresh anything

idle_frames_requested.reason: a settled thread must not request frames or animation deadlines, or the Editor burns CPU while idle

idle_access_nodes_published.reason: a connected screen reader must receive nothing while the window is unchanged

rest_access_nodes.reason: the accessibility tree covers only realized rows, not all 400 items; measured 775

stream_window_rebuilds.reason: each of the 25 stored updates to a streaming reply currently rebuilds the window once (shell_updates); measured 25 to 32, and the budget only allows it to shrink

stream_section_refreshes_per_frame.reason: a frame refreshes the transcript at most once

stream_access_nodes_published_per_frame.reason: a streamed chunk republishes only the changed reply's nodes to a screen reader; measured 62

scroll_window_rebuilds.reason: twenty wheel notches up a 400-item thread rebuild the window only when an older page arrives; measured 7 to 14 depending on when pages land

scroll_section_refreshes_per_frame.reason: a frame refreshes the transcript at most once

scroll_access_nodes_examined_per_frame.reason: each scrolled frame hands the screen-reader bridge the realized rows only; measured 1360

scroll_access_nodes_published_per_frame.reason: a scrolled frame republishes only the nodes that moved into or out of view; measured 223
